articles.summary: Washington Trust Bancorp, Inc. (Nasdaq: WASH; "Washington Trust" or the "Corporation"), today reported third quarter 2026 net income of $19.4 million, up by $3.4 million, or 21%, from the preceding quarter. Diluted earnings per share was $1.01 for the third quarter of 2026, up by $0.18 from the preceding quarter. Compared to the third quarter of 2025, net income was up by $8.5 million, or $0.45 per diluted share. "We delivered another strong quarter marked by growth in earnings and net interest income, continued margin expansion and improved operating efficiency," said Washington Trust Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Edward O. "Ned" Handy III. "By combining personalized service and trusted advice with the capabilities of a regional bank, we are able to provide customers with a level of service, expertise and convenience that stands apart from other community banks our size. We continue to focus on leveraging these strengths to support prudent growth and deliver long-term value
